title: Cosmic Nebula Swirls
description: An abstract painting featuring fluid, smoke-like formations in deep black, gold, teal, and purple hues. Swirling patterns of metallic gold and white speckles create a starry, cosmic effect against the dark background.
prompt: Abstract cosmic painting with fluid swirling smoke formations in deep black and metallic gold, accented by teal and purple wisps. Dense clusters of white and gold speckles create a starry nebula effect throughout the dark background, with organic flowing shapes and luminous particles.
